pages.ko: 아침에 엄마가 예쁜 티셔츠를 꺼내 놓았어요. "호야야, 오늘은 혼자 입어 볼까?" 아기 호야는 형처럼 혼자 입고 싶어서 두 손을 불끈 쥐었어요. "호야가! 호야가 할래!"
pages.t: In the morning, Mom laid out a pretty T-shirt. "Hoya, want to try putting it on by yourself today?" Baby Hoya clenched his little fists, wanting to dress himself just like his big brother. "Hoya do it! Hoya wants to do it!"

pages.ko: 호야가 티셔츠를 머리에 뒤집어썼는데— 어라? 머리가 쏙 안 나와요! 목구멍에 걸려 캄캄, 팔은 어디로 넣는지 모르겠어요. "으으, 안 돼애!" 호야가 옷 속에서 버둥버둥해요.
pages.t: Hoya pulled the T-shirt over his head — huh? His head wouldn't pop out! It got stuck in the neck hole, everything went dark, and he had no idea where his arms were supposed to go. "Uh-oh, no fair!" Hoya wriggled and squirmed inside the shirt.

pages.ko: 겨우 옷을 벗은 호야는 눈에 눈물이 그렁그렁. "호야는 옷도 못 입어…" 시무룩하게 고개를 푹 숙였어요. 혼자 하고 싶었는데 잘 안 되니까 속이 상해요.
pages.t: Hoya finally managed to pull the shirt off, tears welling up in his eyes. "Hoya can't even put on a shirt..." He hung his head sadly. He wanted to do it all by himself, and being unable to do it made him upset.

pages.ko: 엄마가 호야 곁에 앉아 티셔츠를 들어 보였어요. "이건 옷이 아니라 재미있는 터널이야! 머리가 쏙— 터널을 지나가면 돼." 엄마가 옷의 목구멍을 동그랗게 벌려 보여 줘요.
pages.t: Mom sat down beside Hoya and held up the T-shirt. "This isn't just a shirt, it's a fun tunnel! Your head just has to pop through the tunnel." Mom stretched the neck hole open wide to show him.

pages.ko: "머리 터널, 팔 터널, 다리 터널이 있대!" 형 호리가 방으로 쏙 들어와 신나게 외쳤어요. "터널만 지나가면 되는 거야?" 호야 눈이 동그래졌어요. 옷 입기가 갑자기 재미있는 놀이가 됐어요.
pages.t: "There's a head tunnel, an arm tunnel, and a leg tunnel!" Big brother Hori popped into the room and shouted excitedly. "I just have to go through the tunnels?" Hoya's eyes went round. Suddenly, getting dressed had turned into a fun game.

pages.ko: 첫 번째 터널! 호야가 머리를 쑤욱 밀어 넣자 목구멍 터널을 지나 머리가 쏙— 나왔어요! "까꿍! 나왔다!" 호야가 방긋 웃어요. 이제 무섭지 않아요, 그냥 터널일 뿐이니까.
pages.t: The first tunnel! Hoya pushed his head through, and it slipped past the neck tunnel and popped right out! "Peekaboo! There it is!" Hoya grinned. It wasn't scary anymore, since it was just a tunnel after all.

pages.ko: 이제 팔 터널! 호야가 한쪽 팔을 쏙, 또 한쪽 팔을 쏙— 소매 끝으로 작은 손이 쏘옥 나왔어요. 호리와 엄마가 함께 외쳤어요. "쏙쏙 팔, 쑥쑥 다리!" 호야도 신나서 팔을 흔들어요.
pages.t: Now the arm tunnel! Hoya popped one arm through, then popped the other arm through — his little hands slipped right out through the sleeve ends. Hori and Mom cheered together, "Pop pop go the arms, whoosh whoosh go the legs!" Hoya waved his arms happily too.

pages.ko: 마지막은 바지 다리 터널! 한 다리 쑥, 또 한 다리 쑥— 발이 쏘옥 나오고 바지를 쭈욱 올렸어요. 혼자 옷을 다 입었어요! 그 순간 호야 꼬리 줄무늬가 무지개색으로 반짝— 부릉! 해냈어요!
pages.t: Last was the leg tunnel of the pants! One leg through, then the other leg through — his feet popped out and he pulled the pants up snugly. He got dressed all by himself! At that moment, the stripes on Hoya's tail sparkled in rainbow colors — whoosh! He did it!

pages.ko: 이제 호야는 순서를 알아요. 하나, 머리 터널 쏙! 둘, 팔 터널 쏙쏙! 셋, 다리 터널 쑥쑥! 다음 날 아침, 호야가 엄마 없이 혼자 옷을 척척 입었어요. 쏙쏙 팔, 쑥쑥 다리!
pages.t: Now Hoya knows the order. One, pop through the head tunnel! Two, pop pop through the arm tunnels! Three, whoosh whoosh through the leg tunnels! The next morning, Hoya got dressed all by himself, without any help from Mom. Pop pop go the arms, whoosh whoosh go the legs!

pages.ko: 엄마가 호야를 번쩍 안아 볼을 부볐어요. "우리 호야, 이제 옷도 혼자 입는 형아네!" 이제 호야는 알아요. 옷은 무서운 게 아니라, 하나씩 지나가는 즐거운 터널이라는 걸. 쏙쏙 팔, 쑥쑥 다리!
pages.t: Mom scooped Hoya up and nuzzled his cheek. "My Hoya, you're a big kid now who can dress yourself!" Now Hoya knows that clothes aren't scary at all — they're just fun tunnels to pass through, one by one. Pop pop go the arms, whoosh whoosh go the legs!

overview.ko: 옷 입기를 엄마에게 의존하던 호리가 단계별로 배워 스스로 옷을 입게 되는 자립심 동화입니다.
overview.t: An independence story about Hoya, who used to rely on Mom to get dressed, learning step by step to put on his clothes all by himself.

lessons.t: Feel the sense of accomplishment from completing each step.

readingTips.ko: '쏙쏙 척척' 후렴을 옷 입는 동작과 함께 읽어 주세요.
readingTips.t: Read the 'pop pop, all by myself' refrain together while acting out getting dressed.

readingTips.ko: 아이가 한 단계씩 해낼 때 칭찬해 주세요.
readingTips.t: Praise your child each time they master one step.
